summary: Verified from Gogoro pages: EZZY (green plate) is NT$59,980 in four colours until 2026-12-31 (NT$2,000 off). Gogoro's NT$19,680 example needs a Taipei scrap-and-replace subsidy plus central subsidy (NT$40,300 total); the NT$49,300 headline is a campaign maximum, not model-specific. The EZZY NT$151/month plan credit and colour discount may not stack, so ask in store. The 488/888 plan is confirmed: 24-month lock-in, free swaps only 00-06, 10-16, 22-24, otherwise NT$2.3/Ah. Other plan prices (319, 529, $0 plan NT$1.1/Ah with NT$6,000 setup) come from JS-loaded support pages and are not confirmed by me. Corrected: the $0 plan is cheaper than 488 at 300 and 500 km before setup. White-plate prices (EZZY 500 about NT$74,980) remain secondary. Scrap-and-replace and trade-in cannot be combined. FY2025 net loss US$80.8m, cash US$70.6m, director undertook NT$2.5bn equity by end-2026. All promotions end 2026-12-31; 2027 unknown.

findings.subject: Gogoro EZZY (green plate, 普通輕型) promo price
findings.valueText: Promo price NT$59,980 incl. tax in four colours (淺粉、灰藍、淺棕、淡綠), after NT$2,000 off. List NT$61,980 is DERIVED (59,980+2,000), not printed on the page.
findings.quote: 折扣金額 $2,000（含稅），折扣後價格 $59,980（含稅）
findings.conditions: Named colours only, stock-limited, no stacking guarantee
findings.verifierNote: Discount and promo price confirmed. The NT$61,980 list price is arithmetic, not a stated figure. Fine print on both the discount and the NT$151 plan-credit say they may not be combined with other offers that include a vehicle price discount; the page headline nonetheless shows both together, so confirm in store. Do not treat 59,980 as a permanent price.

findings.subject: Gogoro 'lowest price' example for EZZY: NT$19,680
findings.valueText: NT$19,680 = 59,980 - 40,300 (Taipei scrap-and-replace + central). Best case only.
findings.quote: 係指適用台北市汰舊並新購電動機車補助，再加上中央政府補助款之金額共計 $40,300，前述入手價係扣除台北市汰舊並新購電動機車補助金額後之可能最低金額
findings.conditions: Scrap-and-replace in Taipei; quotas may run out; Gogoro says subsidy 'may change or quota exhausted'
findings.verifierNote: Number and arithmetic confirmed. Original quote was misquoted; page says the price is after deducting the subsidy 'possible lowest amount'. Split of 40,300 between Taipei and central is not stated.

findings.subject: Gogoro Luna
findings.valueText: NT$83,980 起 (media only)
findings.verifierNote: inside.com.tw not opened by me; official gogoro.com prices are JS-loaded and absent from HTML. Luna promo page confirms 'lowest not 40k' after Taipei+central, consistent with but not proof of 83,980.

findings.subject: Gogoro 'up to NT$49,300' subsidy headline
findings.valueText: NT$49,300 = Taipei scrap-and-replace + central, 'maximum'. It is a campaign-wide headline on the lastcall page (EZZY, Premium, Luna), not a Luna-specific figure.
findings.quote: 最高補助金額 $49,300：係指適用臺北市汰舊換新電動機車補助方案，並加計中央政府補助款後之金額，僅供參考。
findings.verifierNote: Figure and definition confirmed, but it is a generic maximum for the campaign, not Luna-specific; the researcher's 83,980-49,300=34,680 is a derived estimate on an unverified list price. Filing agent only until 2026/12/10 is confirmed.

findings.subject: Luna NT$6,000 accessory credit

findings.quote: 「配件購物金 $6,000」限於Gogoro 以歸戶後400天(含)內使用完畢，屆期自動失效
findings.verifierNote: 400-day validity, 2026-10-15 to 2026-12-31 and 12/23 delivery deadline seen. Service-centre-only restriction not independently checked. Do not count as price reduction.

findings.verifierNote: Web search budget exhausted; kingautos not opened. Price remains secondary.

findings.verifierNote: '最低入手價不到 $4 萬' definition seen: Taoyuan subsidy + project subsidy + max central. Software bundle not a cash discount.

findings.subject: 騎到飽 NT$488 single / NT$888 two batteries
findings.valueText: 24-month lock-in; swaps free in 00:00-06:00, 10:00-16:00, 22:00-24:00 (14 h/day); NT$2.3/Ah otherwise; early exit NT$2,400 (single) / NT$7,200 (two) x remaining days/730; GoCharger Mobile always NT$2.3/Ah; commercial-use removal above 1,600 Ah two months running.
findings.quote: 每日 00:00 - 06:00、10:00 - 16:00、22:00 - 24:00。 ... 非指定時段內回站電池之電池使用費，費率以每安培小時 2.3 元計算
findings.verifierNote: All items seen on the page. Free only when the swap is completed inside a window by Gogoro's records. Note: the researcher's summary line that 騎到飽 is cheapest at 300 km is wrong, see calc finding.

findings.verifierNote: Dates 2026-09-08 to 2026-12-31 and 3,624 seen. Stacking restriction text seen at '本專案不得與Gogoro指定之其他含車價折扣以及當期促銷之專案或特定優惠方案併同使用'. So the advertised 59,980 plus 168/month may not both apply; ask the shop.

findings.valueText: Old gasoline scooter value credited in full; NOT usable with the government scrap-and-replace subsidy; page quotes 'new-purchase max NT$33,000' (Taipei 民國115 new-purchase + top-up + central).
findings.quote: 本專案恕不適用於政府汰舊換新電動機車補助方案之參加者
findings.verifierNote: Both statements seen. Page URL says 2025 but text states 民國115年 amounts. Choose either scrap-and-replace or this trade-in, not both.

findings.subject: 0% instalments, bank rewards

findings.quote: 享多元付款方案，最高享 36 期 0 利率
findings.verifierNote: 36-instalment 0% to 2026-12-31 seen on lastcall page. HSBC NT$18,000 and other bank claims were not personally verified on the index page. Interest-free financing is not a price cut.

findings.subject: Battery fee per month at 300/500/800/1,000/1,500 km (single battery, 1.4 km/Ah, 2.3 NT$/Ah, no dynamic discount)
findings.verifierNote: Arithmetic re-done and matches, except two corrections: (1) the original summary said 488 is cheapest at 300 and 500 km, but at 300 km the $0 plan costs 236 (486 with setup amortised), cheaper than or equal to 488, and at 500 km 393 (643 with setup) is cheaper than 488 before setup. (2) 488 only wins if swaps fall in windows. Inputs 319/87Ah/1.1/Ah/529 are SECONDARY (support pages JS-loaded); only 488, 2.3/Ah are verified. 1.4 km/Ah is Gogoro's own fleet average and varies by rider. Real-world 488 worst case at heavy use is high.

findings.subject: Owned or home-chargeable battery

findings.quote: Net loss improved by more than $40 million, narrowing substantially to $(80.8) million from $(122.8) million last year.
